subject: Recap & ask — advocate roster, decision owners, and procurement path
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Cho <emily.cho@medbridgehealth.org>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & ask — advocate roster, decision owners, and procurement path

Emily — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + a handful of asks so we can line up the right people on our side and keep procurement moving: 

Call recap (2 min)
- Use case: Pilot to evaluate LLM inference for triage automation across 3 clinics (60k monthly requests).
- Primary success criteria: 95th pct latency < 400ms for common flows; data controls for PHI in VPC; predictable unit cost under target.
- Pilot scope: 6 weeks evaluation, production-readiness handoff if metrics met.

Asks / next steps (concrete)
1) Advocate(s) / sponsor: who is the exec sponsor + day-to-day champion? Please share name(s) + best email.
2) Economic buyer / billing owner: who approves budget and what is the approval cadence?
3) Security / InfoSec owner: name + email to start a short evidence exchange (we have a 1-pager + SOC2).
4) Legal / procurement contact: name/email and any PO/contract templates or redlines we should expect.
5) Typical procurement timeline for pilot → contract (best guess).
6) Any required third-party approvals or compliance gates (privacy board, vendor risk, etc).

Attached: Redwood-MAP-MedBridge.xlsx (mutual action plan draft) and Redwood-Security-OnePager.pdf (high-level evidence).

If you can reply with the names/emails for items 1–4 by EOD Wed (6/30), Ben/Jordan/Neha and I will assemble the short packet and a proposed 30-min intro for the technical/security owners.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Emily Cho <emily.cho@medbridgehealth.org>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & ask — advocate roster, decision owners, and procurement path

Sean — great summary, thanks. Quick answers below and attaching an internal org snapshot (small file).

Champion / day-to-day:
- Dr. Sarah Lee — Director of Clinical Ops (sarah.lee@medbridgehealth.org) — primary champion and will coordinate clinicians in pilot.
Economic buyer / budget owner:
- Procurement lead will manage approvals but final signoff is by Michael Torres (VP Finance) — michael.torres@medbridgehealth.org.
Security / InfoSec:
- Alex Kumar (alex.kumar@medbridgehealth.org) — InfoSec lead; he handles vendor risk and technical security reviews.
Legal / Procurement: 
- procurement@medbridgehealth.org (contracts team), legal@medbridgehealth.org (legal intake).

Timeline: If we get materials this week, internal review (security + procurement) looks like ~10 business days; legal may add another week depending on redlines. Goal would be a PO within ~3 weeks if nothing material slows it down.

Requests from our side: Can you send SOC2/attestation + the short security one-pager you mentioned? Also a one-page technical brief on how you isolate PHI in the private deployment (VPC + KMS flow).

Attaching: MedBridge-org-snapshot.pdf

Thanks — happy to join the intro meeting with Alex and procurement.
Emily
Emily Cho
Head of Clinical Programs | MedBridge Health
emily.cho@medbridgehealth.org | +1 617-555-0198

Jordan: can you prep a 1-page technical brief focused on the VPC flow, KV cache handling for PHI, and latency expectation for the pilot (include simple perf numbers for 2GPU config)?
Neha: can you prepare the SOC2 summary + our short evidence pack (encryption, KMS, retention policy). If we have a short checklist mapping to Alex's vendor questionnaire items, it will speed review.

Proposed owners / deadlines:

- Neha: security packet + checklist by Wed 6/30 EOD
- Sean: schedule intro call with Alex + procurement for Thurs 7/1 or Fri 7/2 (preferred)

Appreciate the quick reply and the org snapshot, Emily — this is perfect. Confirming owners and next steps below: 

Action owners / dates
- Jordan Blake: technical brief (VPC + PHI isolation + perf numbers) — due Wed 6/30 EOD.
- Neha Kapoor: SOC2 summary + vendor evidence checklist tailored to Alex's likely asks — due Wed 6/30 EOD.
- Sean Gallagher: I'll send a calendar invite for a 30-min intro with Alex + procurement for Thu 7/1 10:00am ET (tentative) and include the MAP + one-pager.
- Ben Carter: will handle commercial discussion and hang back on legal sequencing unless procurement requests specific language.

If those deliverables land on Wednesday we can likely get procurement started the same week and aim for a PO by ~7/20 assuming normal review. I'll include the HubSpot deal link and our MAP in the invite.

Emily — would you prefer the intro call to include Michael Torres (VP Finance) or hold finance for the procurement intro? Either is fine; I want to respect your process.

Thanks again — moving quickly on this.
Sean
